examples.en: Cloud computing lets us store files online.
examples.zh: 雲端運算讓我們可以把檔案存在網路上。

examples.en: He is studying computing at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 他在台北的一所大學攻讀電腦科學。

examples.en: The company spends a lot on high-speed computing.
examples.zh: 這間公司在高速運算上花了很多錢。

examples.en: Every plan has its pros and cons.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有優點和缺點。

examples.en: The offer turned out to be a con.
examples.zh: 那項優惠結果是個騙局。

examples.en: Please list the pros and cons of living downtown.
examples.zh: 請列出住在市中心的優缺點。

examples.en: Do not let anyone con you out of your money.
examples.zh: 別讓任何人騙走你的錢。

examples.en: The seller conned several tourists at the market.
examples.zh: 那名賣家在市場裡騙了好幾位遊客。

examples.en: He felt foolish after being conned online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上被騙後覺得自己很傻。

examples.en: His conceit made it hard for him to make friends.
examples.zh: 他的自負讓他很難交到朋友。

examples.en: She spoke about her success without any conceit.
examples.zh: 她談起自己的成就時毫不自大。

examples.en: Too much conceit can stop you from learning.
examples.zh: 過度自負會讓你無法學習。

examples.en: The mayor's remarks drew widespread condemnation from parents at the meeting.
examples.zh: 市長的發言在會議上招來家長們的廣泛譴責。

examples.en: The school voiced its condemnation of cheating.
examples.zh: 學校表達了對作弊行為的譴責。

examples.en: There was public condemnation of the company's unsafe practices.
examples.zh: 大眾對這間公司不安全的做法予以譴責。

examples.en: Health classes teach students how a condom helps prevent disease.
examples.zh: 健康教育課教學生保險套如何幫助預防疾病。

examples.en: You can buy a condom at most pharmacies.
examples.zh: 大多數藥局都買得到保險套。

examples.en: The nurse explained why using a condom is important.
examples.zh: 護理師說明了使用保險套的重要性。

examples.en: The teachers will confer before they decide the grades.
examples.zh: 老師們會先商議再決定成績。

examples.en: I need to confer with my manager about the budget.
examples.zh: 我需要和經理商量預算的事。

examples.en: The university will confer a degree on her next month.
examples.zh: 大學下個月將授予她學位。

examples.en: The configuration of the network took two hours.
examples.zh: 網路的設定花了兩個小時。

examples.en: Please check the configuration before you restart the computer.
examples.zh: 重新啟動電腦前，請先檢查設定。

examples.en: This room has a new seating configuration for the exam.
examples.zh: 這間教室為了考試換了新的座位配置。

examples.en: A congressional committee will review the new law.
examples.zh: 國會委員會將審查這項新法律。

examples.en: She works as a congressional assistant in Washington.
examples.zh: 她在華盛頓擔任國會助理。

examples.en: The congressional vote is scheduled for next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 國會的表決排定在下週二。

senses.zh: 男性國會議員（尤指美國眾議員）

examples.en: The congressman visited our school last week.
examples.zh: 那位國會議員上週來訪我們學校。

examples.en: Our class wrote a letter to a congressman.
examples.zh: 我們班寫了一封信給一位國會議員。

examples.en: The congressman answered questions from local residents.
examples.zh: 那位國會議員回答了當地居民的問題。

examples.en: He lost consciousness for a few seconds after falling.
examples.zh: 他跌倒後失去意識好幾秒。

examples.en: The video raised public consciousness about plastic waste.
examples.zh: 這支影片提升了大眾對塑膠垃圾的認知。

examples.en: She regained consciousness in the hospital after the operation.
examples.zh: 手術後，她在醫院裡恢復了意識。

examples.en: Considering the weather, we should stay home.
examples.zh: 考慮到天氣，我們應該待在家裡。

examples.en: She did well on the test, considering how little time she had.
examples.zh: 就她擁有的時間之少而言，她考得很好。

examples.en: Considering his age, he runs very fast.
examples.zh: 就他的年紀來說，他跑得很快。

examples.en: The company plans to consolidate its two offices.
examples.zh: 公司打算合併兩間辦公室。

examples.en: Regular review helps students consolidate what they learn.
examples.zh: 定期複習能幫助學生鞏固所學。

examples.en: The team worked hard to consolidate its lead.
examples.zh: 球隊努力鞏固自己的領先優勢。

examples.en: A consortium of schools built the new library together.
examples.zh: 幾所學校組成的聯盟共同興建了新圖書館。

examples.en: The consortium will meet next month to discuss funding.
examples.zh: 該聯盟下個月會開會討論資金。

examples.en: Several banks formed a consortium to support the project.
examples.zh: 幾家銀行組成財團來支持這項專案。

examples.en: The red sign is conspicuous from far away.
examples.zh: 那面紅色招牌從很遠的地方就很顯眼。

examples.en: He felt conspicuous in his bright orange jacket.
examples.zh: 他穿著亮橘色外套，覺得自己很引人注目。

examples.en: Her conspicuous absence from the final rehearsal worried her classmates.
examples.zh: 她缺席最後一次彩排一事引人注意，令同學們很擔心。

examples.en: The constable asked the tourists if they needed help.
examples.zh: 那位警員問遊客是否需要協助。

examples.en: A village constable knew everyone in town.
examples.zh: 村裡的警員認識鎮上的每個人。

examples.en: We asked a constable for directions to the station.
examples.zh: 我們向一位警員問往車站的路。

examples.en: The mayor visited every part of her constituency.
examples.zh: 市長走訪了她選區的每個角落。

examples.en: He listens closely to the needs of his constituency.
examples.zh: 他仔細傾聽選區選民的需求。

examples.en: This constituency has more than fifty thousand voters.
examples.zh: 這個選區有五萬多名選民。

examples.en: A constituent called the office to complain about the road.
examples.zh: 一位選民打電話到辦公室抱怨那條路。

examples.en: Water is the main constituent of milk.
examples.zh: 水是牛奶的主要成分。

examples.en: Each constituent of the machine must be tested.
examples.zh: 機器的每個組成部分都必須經過測試。

examples.en: The company sold off its constituent parts.
examples.zh: 那間公司把構成它的各個部門都賣掉了。

examples.en: Each constituent country has its own flag.
examples.zh: 每個組成國都有自己的旗幟。

examples.en: Scientists studied the constituent elements of the rock.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了那塊岩石的組成元素。

examples.en: A small budget can constrain what we are able to do.
examples.zh: 預算很少會限制我們能做的事。

examples.en: School rules should not constrain students' creativity in art classes.
examples.zh: 學校規則不該限制學生在美術課上的創造力。

examples.en: He felt constrained by his strict schedule.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己被緊湊的行程表所束縛。

examples.en: A consuming fear of failure kept him awake before the exam.
examples.zh: 強烈的失敗恐懼讓他在考試前無法入睡。

examples.en: She had a consuming passion for music.
examples.zh: 她對音樂懷有強烈的熱情。

examples.en: Her consuming curiosity led her to read every book on the subject.
examples.zh: 她強烈的好奇心促使她讀遍這個主題的每一本書。

examples.en: The test found a contaminant in the water.
examples.zh: 檢測在水中發現了汙染物。

examples.en: Filters remove any contaminant from the air.
examples.zh: 濾網會去除空氣中的任何汙染物。

examples.en: Even a tiny contaminant can ruin the experiment.
examples.zh: 就算是微量的雜質也可能毀掉實驗。

examples.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
examples.zh: 他靜靜地坐在湖邊沉思。

examples.en: After long contemplation, she chose to study abroad.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的考慮，她決定出國讀書。

examples.en: The garden is a good place for contemplation.
examples.zh: 這座花園是沉思的好地方。

examples.en: She is a strong contender for the gold medal.
examples.zh: 她是奪得金牌的有力競爭者。

examples.en: Three contenders entered the final round of the contest.
examples.zh: 三位競爭者進入了比賽的決賽。

examples.en: Our school is a serious contender in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 我們學校是演講比賽中實力堅強的競爭者。

examples.en: A warm meal at home gave him great contentment.
examples.zh: 在家吃頓熱騰騰的飯讓他十分滿足。

examples.en: She smiled with contentment as she read her book.
examples.zh: 她一邊讀書一邊滿足地微笑。

examples.en: Contentment does not depend on having a lot of money.
examples.zh: 知足並不取決於擁有多少錢。

examples.en: A large contingent of Taiwanese students joined the trip.
examples.zh: 一大群台灣學生參加了這趟旅行。

examples.en: Our contingent arrived at the stadium early.
examples.zh: 我們這一隊提早抵達了體育場。

examples.en: The Japanese contingent was the first to enter the hall.
examples.zh: 日本代表團是第一個進入大廳的。

examples.en: Our plans are contingent on the weather.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫要視天氣而定。

examples.en: The offer is contingent upon a good interview.
examples.zh: 這份工作機會取決於面試表現是否良好。

examples.en: Payment is contingent on the work being finished.
examples.zh: 付款以工作完成為條件。

examples.en: The two reports gave contradictory answers about the cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 這兩份報告對事故原因提出了互相矛盾的答案。

examples.en: His words and actions are completely contradictory.
examples.zh: 他的言語和行為完全相互矛盾。

examples.en: We heard contradictory news about the flight.
examples.zh: 我們聽到關於班機的消息互相矛盾。

senses.zh: 投稿人；捐贈者；促成因素

examples.en: She is a regular contributor to the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 她是校刊的固定投稿人。

examples.en: The museum thanked every contributor for their gifts.
examples.zh: 博物館感謝每一位捐贈者的捐贈。

examples.en: Exercise is a major contributor to good health.
examples.zh: 運動是促進健康的主要因素。

examples.en: She managed to contrive a way to meet him.
examples.zh: 她設法想出辦法見到他。

examples.en: The students contrived a plan to surprise their teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們策劃了一個要給老師驚喜的計畫。

examples.en: We contrived to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們想辦法在截止日前完成了專案。

examples.en: Several roads converge near the train station.
examples.zh: 幾條道路在火車站附近匯合。

examples.en: Fans converged on the stadium before the game.
examples.zh: 球迷在比賽前聚集到體育場。

examples.en: Our opinions began to converge after a long talk.
examples.zh: 經過長談之後，我們的意見開始趨於一致。

examples.en: Some people enjoy crowds; conversely, others avoid them.
examples.zh: 有些人喜歡人群；相反地，也有人避開人群。

examples.en: Prices rose in the city. Conversely, they fell in the country.
examples.zh: 城市的物價上漲，相反地，鄉下的物價下跌。

examples.en: Good sleep improves learning; conversely, poor sleep makes studying more difficult.
examples.zh: 睡得好能提升學習效果；反過來說，睡不好會讓讀書更吃力。

examples.en: He drove his red convertible along the coast.
examples.zh: 他開著紅色敞篷車沿著海岸行駛。

examples.en: My uncle bought a used convertible last summer.
examples.zh: 我叔叔去年夏天買了一輛二手敞篷車。

examples.en: We put the top down on the convertible and enjoyed the breeze.
examples.zh: 我們把敞篷車的車頂收起來，享受微風。

examples.en: This sofa is convertible into a bed.
examples.zh: 這張沙發可以變成一張床。

examples.en: The company issued convertible bonds last year.
examples.zh: 這間公司去年發行了可轉換債券。

examples.en: A convertible currency can be exchanged for others.
examples.zh: 可兌換貨幣能和其他貨幣互相兌換。

examples.en: A convoy of trucks carried food to the village.
examples.zh: 一列卡車車隊把食物運到村子裡。

examples.en: The convoy stopped at a rest area for lunch.
examples.zh: 車隊在休息站停下來吃午餐。

examples.en: Several buses traveled together in a convoy.
examples.zh: 好幾輛公車組成車隊一起行駛。

examples.en: A cop helped us cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 一位警察協助我們穿越繁忙的馬路。

examples.en: The cop asked him to move his car.
examples.zh: 那位警察要他把車移開。

examples.en: My neighbor works as a cop in the city.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居在市區當警察。

examples.en: The host gave us a cordial welcome at the door.
examples.zh: 主人在門口熱情地歡迎我們。

examples.en: They have always had a cordial relationship.
examples.zh: 他們一直維持著友好的關係。

examples.en: Her cordial smile made the new students feel at ease.
examples.zh: 她親切的笑容讓新生感到自在。

examples.en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle.
examples.zh: 他把瓶子的軟木塞拔出來。

examples.en: The notice board is made of cork.
examples.zh: 這塊布告欄是用軟木做的。

examples.en: Please put the cork back after you pour the wine.
examples.zh: 倒完酒後，請把軟木塞塞回去。

examples.en: The medical corps sent doctors to the flooded area.
examples.zh: 醫療團派醫師前往淹水地區。

examples.en: She joined a drum and bugle corps at her school.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校的鼓號樂隊。

examples.en: A corps of volunteers cleaned the beach.
examples.zh: 一群志工把海灘打掃乾淨。

examples.en: The teacher made a correction on my essay.
examples.zh: 老師在我的作文上做了修改。

examples.en: The newspaper printed a correction the next day.
examples.zh: 報紙隔天刊登了更正啟事。

examples.en: Please hand in your corrections by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前交出你的訂正。

examples.en: Height and weight often correlate in children.
examples.zh: 孩童的身高與體重常常相關。

examples.en: Researchers found that sleep correlates with test scores.
examples.zh: 研究人員發現睡眠與考試成績有關聯。

examples.en: It is hard to correlate the two sets of data.
examples.zh: 很難把這兩組資料互相關聯起來。

examples.en: Height is a correlate of age in young children.
examples.zh: 在年幼的孩子身上，身高是和年齡相關的因素。

examples.en: Scientists studied a correlate of the disease.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了這種疾病的一個相關因素。

examples.en: Each variable has its own correlate in the second table.
examples.zh: 每個變數在第二張表中都有各自的對應項目。

examples.en: Salt water can corrode metal very quickly.
examples.zh: 鹽水會很快腐蝕金屬。

examples.en: The old pipes began to corrode after years of use.
examples.zh: 舊水管用了多年後開始腐蝕。

examples.en: Moisture can corrode the bike's metal parts if you leave it outside.
examples.zh: 如果把腳踏車放在外面，濕氣可能會腐蝕它的金屬零件。

examples.en: Scientists study cosmic rays from deep space.
examples.zh: 科學家研究來自外太空深處的宇宙射線。

examples.en: The telescope took a picture of a cosmic cloud.
examples.zh: 這台望遠鏡拍下了一片宇宙星雲的照片。

examples.en: The size of the universe is a cosmic mystery.
examples.zh: 宇宙究竟有多大，是個宇宙之謎。

senses.zh: 國際化的；世界性的；見多識廣的

examples.en: Taipei is a modern and cosmopolitan city.
examples.zh: 台北是一座現代又國際化的城市。

examples.en: She has a cosmopolitan view of the world.
examples.zh: 她對世界抱持著開闊的國際視野。

examples.en: The cosmopolitan crowd at the festival came from many countries.
examples.zh: 慶典上國際化的人群來自許多國家。

examples.en: The costing of the new building took several weeks.
examples.zh: 新大樓的成本核算花了好幾週。

examples.en: A detailed costing showed that we need more money.
examples.zh: 詳細的估價顯示我們需要更多資金。

examples.en: The accountant finished the costing before the meeting.
examples.zh: 會計師在會議前完成了成本核算。

examples.en: The councilor promised to repair the park.
examples.zh: 那位議員承諾要修繕公園。

examples.en: A local councilor spoke at our school.
examples.zh: 一位地方議員到我們學校演講。

examples.en: Residents wrote to the councilor about the noise.
examples.zh: 居民寫信給議員反映噪音問題。

examples.en: Turn the lid counterclockwise to open the jar.
examples.zh: 把蓋子逆時針轉就能打開罐子。

examples.en: The runners went counterclockwise around the track.
examples.zh: 跑者們沿著跑道逆時針跑。

examples.en: Turn the handle counterclockwise to open the bathroom window.
examples.zh: 逆時針轉動把手，就能打開浴室窗戶。

examples.en: The machine makes a counterclockwise turn before returning to its starting position.
examples.zh: 這台機器先逆時針轉動，再回到起始位置。

examples.en: Use a counterclockwise motion to loosen the screw.
examples.zh: 用逆時針的動作來鬆開螺絲。

examples.en: The counterclockwise path leads to the exit.
examples.zh: 逆時針方向的路徑通往出口。

examples.en: Countless stars shine in the sky on a clear night.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，天上有無數的星星閃耀。

examples.en: She has read countless books since she was a child.
examples.zh: 她從小就讀過無數的書。

examples.en: Countless people visit the night market every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末都有無數的人造訪夜市。

examples.en: The army leader took power in a coup.
examples.zh: 那名軍事領袖透過政變奪得了權力。

examples.en: Winning the contract was a real coup for the company.
examples.zh: 贏得那份合約對公司而言是一大成就。

examples.en: The coup surprised people around the world.
examples.zh: 那場政變讓全世界的人都很驚訝。

examples.en: A courier delivered the package to our door.
examples.zh: 一位快遞員把包裹送到我們家門口。

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign for the letter.
examples.zh: 快遞員請我在信件上簽收。

examples.en: We sent the original documents to the client by courier.
examples.zh: 我們用快遞把文件正本寄給客戶。

examples.en: Please courier the contract to our office this afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在今天下午把合約以快遞寄到我們辦公室。

examples.en: She couriered the gift to her friend in Japan.
examples.zh: 她把禮物用快遞寄給在日本的朋友。

examples.en: The documents were couriered overnight so they would arrive before the meeting.
examples.zh: 這些文件以隔日送達的快遞寄送，以便在會議前抵達。

examples.en: A thick covering of snow lay on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋頂上覆蓋著一層厚厚的雪。

examples.en: The table has a plastic covering to keep it clean.
examples.zh: 桌子上有一層塑膠罩保持乾淨。

examples.en: Put a covering over the bowl to keep out flies.
examples.zh: 在碗上蓋個東西，以免蒼蠅飛進去。

examples.en: Many collectors covet this rare stamp because of its unusual design.
examples.zh: 許多收藏家因為這張稀有郵票的獨特設計，而渴望擁有它。

examples.en: He secretly coveted his friend's new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他暗自渴望擁有朋友的新腳踏車。

examples.en: The coveted prize went to a student from our school.
examples.zh: 那個令人夢寐以求的獎項由我們學校的一位學生拿下。

senses.zh: 廢話；劣質品（口語，較粗俗）

examples.en: I am tired of listening to his crap.
examples.zh: 我聽膩了他的廢話。

examples.en: The toy broke in one day because it was crap.
examples.zh: 那個玩具品質很差，一天就壞了。

examples.en: Do not believe all the crap you read online.
examples.zh: 別相信你在網路上讀到的所有胡說八道。

examples.en: The old door began to creak when I pushed it.
examples.zh: 我一推那扇老舊的門，它就發出嘎吱聲。

examples.en: The stairs creak every time someone walks up.
examples.zh: 每次有人走上樓梯，階梯就嘎吱作響。

examples.en: The wooden chair creaked under his weight.
examples.zh: 那張木椅承受著他的體重，嘎吱作響。

examples.en: We heard a creak from the attic.
examples.zh: 我們聽到閣樓傳來嘎吱聲。

examples.en: The creak of the gate woke the dog.
examples.zh: 大門的嘎吱聲吵醒了那隻狗。

examples.en: With a loud creak, the window opened.
examples.zh: 窗戶伴隨著一聲響亮的嘎吱聲打開了。
